source.text: 36. An Amendment To Be Offered by Representative Moore of West Virginia or His Designee, Debatable for 10 Minutes Page 802, line 15, strike ```Any person''' and insert the following: ``(1) In general.--Except as specified in paragraph (2), any person''. Page 802, after line 20, add the following: ``(2) Exception.--The penalties specified in paragraph (1) shall not apply with respect to a violation of any of paragraphs (1) through (5) of subsection (a) that involves conduct occurring-- ``(A) in the State of West Virginia; and ``(B) at a commercial greyhound racing track that is active on the date of enactment of the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026.''.
